# Global Winners (2025)

What won last year. Use it to see the bar and what judges reward.

## Most Inspirational

The project that captures our hearts.

### Photonics Odyssey: AakashNet A Region-optimized, Low-cost, Hybrid Satellite-mesh Broadband System Designed For Indian Infrastructure And Socio-economic Constraints.

- Challenge: Commercializing Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
- Local event: Chennai
- Links: [demo](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG07mTTm3U/2Md3dzae0X5hpQ9ut1OjXg/edit?utm_content=DAG07mTTm3U&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton) · [project](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17Sjo9YEayU1WuYzge4OO2uTpEkqAI4ms) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/photonic-force/)

> AakashNet is an indigenous Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network designed to provide secure, high-speed, and affordable internet connectivity across India’s diverse terrain. We developed a phased-array based user terminal capable of dynamic beam steering through Ku/Ka band communication, linking directly with AakashNet satellites in orbit. These satellites form a laser-linked mesh network, enabling continuous data relay with minimal latency and reduced ground dependency.

> The system directly addresses India’s connectivity challenges—bridging the digital divide in rural regions, providing encrypted communication for defense posts, and delivering in-flight and maritime internet without relying on foreign networks. With hardware locally produced by Indian agencies like ISRO, HAL, and BHEL, AakashNet ensures technological sovereignty and strategic independence.

> By combining indigenous satellite manufacturing, reusable ISRO launches, and adaptive phased-array ground technology, AakashNet transforms connectivity into a national infrastructure asset—empowering governance, education, defense, and the digital economy.

## Best Mission Concept

The project with the most plausible concept and design.

### PureFlow: PureFlow

- Challenge: Your Home in Space: The Habitat Layout Creator
- Local event: Aracaju
- Links: [demo](https://youtu.be/hHUpo7bTVuc) · [project](https://larasdiniz.github.io/PureFlow-2025/src/public/html/home/home.html) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/pureflow2/)

> We developed PureFlow, an interactive systems engineering platform that allows users to design, model in 3D, and validate space habitats. It directly addresses the challenge by enabling the creation of layouts and volumes, but it goes further: the system calculates critical crew requirements in real-time (mass, power, life support) based on crew size and mission duration, providing instant feedback on the design's viability.

> Its importance lies in being more than a layout tool; it is a survival simulator. With its unique integration of NASA's DONKI API, PureFlow tests the design against real space weather threats, such as solar storms. It doesn't just answer if a habitat can be built, but if its crew can survive in it, making resilient design a fundamental priority.

## Galactic Impact

The project with the most potential to improve life on Earth or in the universe.

### Astro Sweepers - We Catch What Space Leaves Behind: Astro Sweepers – AI‑powered orbital debris compliance and risk intelligence

- Challenge: Commercializing Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
- Local event: Universal Event
- Links: [demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1L3cIR8WZdzdp7eUY3leIToGTbnMiBT4N/view?usp=sharing) · [project](https://astro-sweepers.vercel.app/) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/astro-sweepers-we-catch-what-space-leaves-behind/)

> Astro Sweepers is a compliance‑and‑insight platform that automates NASA’s Debris Assessment Software (DAS) workflow, generates ODAR/EOMP reports and produces clear, actionable risk scores for space operators. It uses our proprietary ASRI index to weight debris legacy, compliance readiness, collision‑risk burden and sustainability alignment, combining NASA SPARK/Space‑Track data and DAS outputs to produce before and after risk scores and long‑term debris population forecasts. The system includes a user‑friendly web portal that transforms technical analyses into intuitive dashboards and business‑ready reports, helping customers reduce post‑mission lifetimes, lower casualty risks and demonstrate regulatory compliance to insurers, investors and agencies. Ultimately, Astro Sweepers aims to mitigate the mounting orbital‑debris crisis by tying immediate DAS compliance with longer‑term sustainability forecasting and a scalable business model, enabling safer, more sustainable access to low Earth orbit.

## Local Impact

The project that demonstrates the greatest potential for local impact.

### QUEÑARIS: Queñaris

- Challenge: BloomWatch: An Earth Observation Application for Global Flowering Phenology
- Local event: Arequipa
- Links: [demo](https://youtu.be/QvbLhHqKULc) · [project](https://quenaris.vercel.app) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/watana-project/)

> We developed Queñaris, a platform for the smart reforestation of queñua forests. It is a comprehensive system that combines the use of native microorganisms, NASA satellite data, drones, and artificial intelligence to accelerate tree growth, identify the best areas for reforestation, and monitor the health of the ecosystem.
The project addresses critical water scarcity in Arequipa, caused by the degradation of queñua forests, which are vital for water retention. While traditional reforestation methods are slow and not very scalable, our platform uses technology to create a massive and efficient strategy. By digitizing the terrain and analyzing phenological data, we can make evidence-based decisions to maximize the impact of each tree planted.
This is crucial because the loss of queñua forests has a direct impact on water security in Arequipa. The drastic reduction in spring flow (from 14 L/s to 0 in days) threatens the water supply for human consumption, agribusiness (28.5%), energy (67.7%), and mining (11%), creating the risk of food crises and social conflicts. Restoring these forests means restoring the water balance and ensuring a sustainable future for the region.

## Global Connection

The project that best connects people around the world through technology.

### Gaia+LEO: Project Gaia+LEO

- Challenge: Commercializing Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
- Local event: Seattle, WA
- Links: [demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17eORY_V279WEXn_29pDwuUACGKpyKx6K/view) · [project](https://github.com/stayingfoolish/gaia-LEO/blob/main/README.md) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/gaialeo/)

> We developed Gaia-LEO, a mixed-integer optimization framework that co-designs orbital and terrestrial data-center networks for the next generation of AI and Earth-observation workloads. The model jointly optimizes facility location, network topology, and workload placement by minimizing total CapEx + OpEx while satisfying real-world physical constraints latency, bandwidth, power, and thermal limits. Each orbital module represents a 40 MW containerized data-center node with solar power and radiative cooling; ground sites anchor fiber backhaul and user access. Using inputs from NASA’s CO2 emissions, water & orbital debris data and web scraped data center data the solver decides which orbital clusters to launch, which ground points of presence to activate, and how to route traffic through optical & inter-satellite links.

> This framework directly addresses the challenge of commercializing LEO by quantifying when and where orbital compute becomes economically advantageous compared with terrestrial infrastructure. It transforms space from a communications relay into a computational layer – a sustainable, solar-powered extension of Earth’s cloud. The result is an actionable blueprint for scaling AI training and climate modeling in orbit, reducing terrestrial power and water footprints, and accelerating humanity’s transition toward space-based green compute as part of the emerging orbital economy.

## Best Use of Technology

The project that exemplifies the most innovative use of technology.

### Twisters: SkySense

- Challenge: Will It Rain On My Parade?
- Local event: Monterrey
- Links: [demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LDaKDOHBKm3PxC03xcEJGfdybsVEwOTf/view?usp=sharing) · [project](https://skysense.surf/) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/twisters/)

> SkySense is a web-app platform that uses NASA Earth observation data and AI analysis to provide ultra-local and personalized weather predictions. Our goal is to help users plan outdoor events, sports, and travel with greater accuracy and confidence. By integrating NASA, Google, and Gemini APIs, SkySense analyzes multiple weather variables such as rain, wind, temperature, humidity, and visibility to generate real-time risk assessments and suggest the safest time windows for activities. 
The platform also features TwisterBot, a smart conversational assistant that delivers adaptive alerts, reminders, and weather insights directly to the user.
SkySense addresses the challenge of unreliable, generic forecasts by making meteorological data understandable and actionable. It would empower individuals and organizations to make informed decisions, reduce weather-related risks, and transform uncertainty into confidence.

## Best Use of Data

The project that best makes space data accessible or leverages it for a unique application.

### Resonant Exoplanets: Project Resonant Exoplanets

- Challenge: A World Away: Hunting for Exoplanets with AI
- Local event: Mountain View, CA
- Links: [demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5fBB5YJpfwU) · [project](https://resonant-planet.vercel.app) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/resonant-exoplanets/)

> Resonant Worlds Explorer is an AI-powered system that ingests telescope and satellite data, including spectra from missions like JWST, to search for exoplanets and detect possible biosignatures. Unlike traditional tools that rely on approximate floating-point methods, our system integrates Modulus, a new exact-math solver that converts physics and chemistry problems into number theory and solves them without numerical error. This allows us to model planetary atmospheres with high precision, test chemical equilibrium, and distinguish true biosignatures (like O₂ + CH₄ coexistence) from abiotic false positives.
We built a full end-to-end pipeline: fetching NASA data, detecting exoplanets with transit algorithms, validating signals with physics models, and running Modulus-based chemistry checks. Results are presented in a web interface with visual plots and automatically generated scientific reports.
This matters because the search for life beyond Earth depends on accuracy. By combining astronomy data, physics validation, and exact chemistry, Resonant Worlds Explorer reduces false positives and provides a reliable way to identify promising candidates for habitability, helping guide future missions and discoveries.

## Best Use of Science

The project that makes the best and most valid use of science and/or the scientific method.

### SpaceGenes+: SpaceGenes+: A Synergy Dashboard for Molecular Space Health

- Challenge: Build a Space Biology Knowledge Engine
- Local event: Berlin
- Links: [demo](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nUliPCPSrPXtbi7LartC2WfROIni7pFv/view?usp=sharing) · [project](https://spacegenes-plus.framer.website/) · [team page](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/find-a-team/spacegenes/)

> SpaceGenes+ is an interactive dashboard designed to uncover synergistic gene expression changes in space biology: specifically, how radiation and microgravity together impact astronaut health at the molecular level. Using real NASA GeneLab datasets (OSD-288 Transcriptome analysis of murine spleen in space), our tool identifies genes like TP53, ATM, and GADD45A that exhibit non-additive responses when exposed to multiple spaceflight stressors.

> This dashboard empowers researchers, drug developers, and mission planners to quickly visualize synergy effects across different conditions: radiation only, microgravity only, and combined spaceflight. In future, users will be able to filter by organ system, biological function, and stressor type, enabling faster hypothesis generation and precision targeting for space medicine and cancer biology.

> SpaceGenes+ addresses a major challenge: most space omics tools treat stressors in isolation. Yet, in real missions, astronauts experience overlapping biological stress. Recognizing these hidden molecular interactions is essential for developing protective measures and advancing long-duration spaceflight.
